description: Convert an EU electronic invoice from one EN 16931 format to another. Pass the source document (inline via document, or a file via documentPath) and set targetFormat. An XML source comes back as XML inline for every target, facturx and zugferd included: XML is not wrapped into a hybrid PDF. A hybrid PDF source sent to facturx or zugferd comes back as a PDF, written to the outputPath you give: the PDF as sent, with only its annotation flags normalised for PDF/A and its container not checked, when its embedded XML already is the target; otherwise that PDF re-wrapped around the converted XML, returned only after veraPDF passed it against PDF/A-3b. With a test key the PDF is watermarked after any veraPDF check, so do not say veraPDF checked the file returned. A successful result means the API validated the invoice XML before returning it. For a facturx or zugferd target at profile en16931 that validation is the one for plain EN 16931 CII: no Factur-X profile schema is checked. It carries no verdict and no check depth; a converted document that fails comes back as an error that lists the failed rules. lostElementsCount is how many source elements the engine recorded as having no target equivalent. A loss the engine does not detect is not counted, so 0 does not say that every field of the source arrived. lostElements lists those losses, each with its path, value, reason, severity and acceptableLoss. When the list would pass the API's 6 KB header cap, it holds one { truncated: true } entry instead of the losses, and lostElementsCount stays the exact count. beliq produces the converted document and does not send it: delivery through beliq is in development. Until it is available, transmission (Peppol, plateforme agréée, SDI) and tax-authority reporting stay with your access point; archiving stays with you, and beliq does not operate KSeF submission.

document.description: The source invoice as XML text. Provide this OR documentPath, not both.

documentPath.description: Path to the source invoice on disk: a UBL/CII XML, or a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF. Provide this OR document.

dropFranceCtcOverlay.description: Drop the French CTC overlay from the converted document.

outputPath.description: Where to write the converted document on disk. Required when a PDF source goes to a facturx or zugferd target, optional otherwise. The call fails if a file already exists at the path.

sourceFormat.description: Source format hint. 'auto' (default) detects it from the document.

targetFormat.description: Format to convert to. An XML source comes back as XML inline for every target, facturx and zugferd included. A hybrid PDF source sent to facturx or zugferd comes back as a PDF and needs outputPath.

targetProfile.description: Profile for a facturx or zugferd target; ignored for the XML targets.

name: beliq_convert_einvoice

lostElements.description: The losses counted in lostElementsCount, each as https://docs.beliq.eu/api-reference/convert/#lostelement-schema describes, or the one truncation entry the tool description names.

path.description: XPath of the lost element in the source document.

output.description: What came back, read from the response: xml, or pdf for a returned hybrid PDF.

title: beliq: Convert E-Invoice
